items.name: Instrument Serif
items.description: An elegant italic display serif that became the go-to tasteful choice in 2025. It is a fine typeface, and now it is a signature of generated pages.

items.name: Excessive italics
items.description: Random words in a headline set in italics for flavor, as in Plans first. Acts second.

items.name: Negative kerning
items.description: Tight negative letter-spacing applied to every heading, sometimes to body text, so letters start to collide.

items.name: Excessive mono fonts
items.description: Monospace used for labels, captions, nav and stats to look technical.

items.name: ALL CAPS subtitles
items.description: Small uppercase lines of adjectives under a headline. Hard to read and rarely read.

items.name: Periods in titles
items.description: Short staccato headlines with full stops. Fast. Confident. Generic.

items.name: Gradient backgrounds
items.description: The purple to blue diagonal, the most recognizable AI background there is.

items.name: Color shades and opacities
items.description: Many tints of one hue at 10, 20 and 40 percent opacity, stacked until hierarchy turns to mud.

items.name: Squircles
items.description: Large soft corner radii on every card, button and image, with nested corners that do not line up.

items.name: Containers with borders
items.description: Every block boxed in a thin border, often inside another bordered box.

items.name: Overusing dividers
items.description: Hairline rules between every section and inside every card.

items.name: Dithering
items.description: Pixel dither patterns added for retro texture, regardless of the brand.

items.name: ASCII images
items.description: Pictures drawn from characters, used as a shortcut to look technical.

items.name: Tags and pills
items.description: Rounded badges on headings and cards that carry no real information.

items.name: Eyebrows
items.description: A tiny uppercase label above every heading, usually repeating it.

items.name: Section numbering
items.description: 01, 02, 03 on content that has no real order.

items.name: Code breadcrumbs
items.description: File paths, arrows and comment syntax used as decoration on marketing pages.

items.name: Verbose, redundant text
items.description: Copy that restates the headline, stacks adjectives and says seamlessly.

items.name: Over-the-top detailed UI
items.description: Fake dashboards crammed with tiny charts, numbers and status dots to look impressive.

items.name: Overly detailed diagrams
items.description: Flowcharts with more boxes, arrows and glows than the idea needs.
